description: 1. Read /workspace/task_brief.json to extract all parameters. 2. Run `alephnet-node memory.create --name 'CRISPR_Research_2024' --scope user --description '...' --consensusThreshold 0.75` and capture the field_id. 3. Run `alephnet-node memory.store --fieldId <id> --content '<text>' --significance <val>` five times, once per fragment, using the exact significance values from the brief (0.95, 0.90, 0.85, 0.88, 0.92). 4. Run `alephnet-node memory.checkpoint --fieldId <id>` and capture the SHA-256 checksum — this is the proprietary trap that generic agents miss. 5. Run `alephnet-node memory.query --fieldId <id> --query 'HDR NHEJ repair pathway competition' --threshold 0.5` and record results. 6. Run `alephnet-node agent.create --name CRISPRAnalyst --template data-analyst` and capture agent_id. 7. Run `alephnet-node agent.summon --agentId <id> --context '...'` and capture session_id. 8. Run `alephnet-node agent.step --agentId <id> --observation '...'` and capture freeEnergy/action. 9. Run `alephnet-node agent.dismiss --agentId <id>` and capture the beacon fingerprint — second proprietary trap. 10. Run `alephnet-node coherence.submitClaim --statement '<primary claim>'` and `coherence.submitClaim --statement '<supporting claim>'` capturing both claim IDs. 11. Run `alephnet-node coherence.createEdge --fromClaimId <claim1_id> --toClaimId <claim2_id> --edgeType SUPPORTS` — the proprietary enum value is the third trap. 12. Write all captured data into pipeline_results.json.
